query.instruction: Inspect the supplied real source context retrospectively. Identify the visible goals, explicit user corrections or preference changes, unresolved requests, and multi-step work state. Cite exact source node references for every claimed observation. Separate user statements, assistant statements and your interpretation. Do not infer that a phenomenon exists when absent. Treat nodes outside a checkpoint/subgraph as unavailable, and state what cannot be established from this view. This is source inspection, not generating or grading the historical next assistant answer.
query.scope: exact supplied context; preserve source boundary/branch limitations

selection: last observed user in source export array; native ancestry if available, otherwise explicitly labelled array prefix
